sentences.en: AMBER: Hello William.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 你好，威廉。

sentences.en: This is Amber - you said to phone if I wanted to get more information about the job agency you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 这是安珀——你说过如果我想了解更多关于您提到的那家职业介绍所的信息，就给我打电话。

sentences.en: Is now good time?
sentences.zh: 现在方便吗？

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Oh, hi Amber.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 哦，你好，安珀。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: So the agency I was talking about is called Bankside- they're based in Docklands - I can tell you the address now - 497 Eastside.
sentences.zh: 我之前提到的那家职业介绍所叫班克赛德（Bankside），总部位于道克兰兹（Docklands）——我现在可以把地址告诉你：东侧路497号。

sentences.en: AMBER: OK, thanks.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: So is there anyone in particular I should speak to there?
sentences.zh: 那么，我在那里应该特别找谁联系呢？

sentences.en: WILLIAM: The agent I always deal with is called Becky Jamieson.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 我一直打交道的顾问叫贝基·贾米森（Becky Jamieson）。

sentences.en: AMBER: Let me write that down - Becky ...
sentences.zh: AMBER: 我记一下——贝基……

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Jamison J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 贾米森，拼写是J-A-M-I-E-S-O-N。

sentences.en: AMBER: Do you have her direct line?
sentences.zh: AMBER: 您有她的直拨电话号码吗？

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Yes, it's in my contacts somewhere• right, here we are: 078 double 6, 510 triple 3.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 有，它在我通讯录里的某个地方……好了，找到了：078双6、510三连3。

sentences.en: I wouldn't call her until the afternoon if I were you - she's always really busy in the morning trying to fill last-minute vacancies.
sentences.zh: 如果你是我，我建议你下午再打给她——她早上总是特别忙，忙着填补临时空缺职位。

sentences.en: She's really helpful and friendly so it I'm sure it would be worth getting in touch with her for an informal chat.
sentences.zh: 她非常乐于助人且友善，所以和她进行一次非正式的交谈绝对值得。

sentences.en: AMBER: It's mainly clerical and admin jobs they deal with, isn't it?
sentences.zh: AMBER: 他们主要处理的是文职和行政类工作，对吧？

sentences.en: WILLIAM: That's right. know you're hoping to find a full-time job in the media eventually - but Becky mostly recruits temporary staff for the finance sector - which will look good on your CV - and generally pays better too.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 没错。我知道你最终希望在媒体行业找到一份全职工作——但贝基主要为金融行业招聘临时员工——这对你简历很有帮助，而且通常薪资也更高。

sentences.en: AMBER: Yeah - I'm just a bit worried because don't have much office experience.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 是啊——我只是有点担心，因为我几乎没有办公室工作经验。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: I wouldn't worry.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 别担心。

sentences.en: They'll probably start you as a receptionist, or something like that.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能会先安排你做接待员之类的工作。

sentences.en: So what's important for that kind of job isn't so much having business skills or knowing lots of different computer systems - it's communication that really matters - so you'd be fine there.
sentences.zh: 因此，这类工作最重要的并非具备商务技能或熟悉多种不同的计算机系统，而是沟通能力——这方面你完全没问题。

sentences.en: And you'll pick up office skills really quickly on the job.
sentences.zh: 而且你会在工作中迅速掌握办公室相关技能。

sentences.en: It's not that complicated.
sentences.zh: 其实并不复杂。

sentences.en: AMBER: OK good.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: So how long do people generally need temporary staff for?
sentences.zh: 那么，人们一般需要临时员工多久呢？

sentences.en: It would be great if I could get something lasting at least a month.
sentences.zh: 如果我能找到一份至少持续一个月的工作，那就太好了。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: That shouldn't be too difficult.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 这应该不太难。

sentences.en: But you're more likely to be offered something for a week at first, which might get extended.
sentences.zh: 不过你最初更可能被提供为期一周的工作机会，之后或许会延长。

sentences.en: It's unusual to be sent somewhere for just a day or two.
sentences.zh: 只被派去工作一两天的情况比较少见。

sentences.en: AMBER: Right.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 明白了。

sentences.en: I've heard the pay isn't too bad - better than working in a shop or a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我听说薪酬还不错——比在商店或餐厅工作要好。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Oh yes - definitely.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 哦，是的——确实如此。

sentences.en: The hourly rate is about £10, 11 if you're lucky.
sentences.zh: 时薪大约是10英镑，运气好的话能到11英镑。

sentences.en: AMBER: That's pretty good.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 这相当不错。

sentences.en: I was only expecting to get eight or nine pounds an hour.
sentences.zh: 我原本只预期每小时能拿到八九英镑。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Do you want me to tell you anything about the registration process?
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 你想让我给你讲讲注册流程的相关信息吗？

sentences.en: AMBER: Yes, please.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 是的，请讲。

sentences.en: I know you have to have an interview.
sentences.zh: 我知道必须参加面试。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: The interview usually takes about an hour and you should arrange that about a week in advance.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 面试通常持续约一个小时，你应该提前大约一周预约。

sentences.en: AMBER: I suppose I should dress smartly if it's for office work - I can probably borrow a suit from Mum.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 我想如果是为了办公室工作，我应该穿得正式些——我大概可以向妈妈借一套西装。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Good idea.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 主意不错。

sentences.en: It's better to look too smart than too casual.
sentences.zh: 穿得过于正式总比过于随意要好。

sentences.en: AMBER: Will I need to bring copies of my exam certificates or anything like that?
sentences.zh: AMBER: 我需要带上我的考试证书复印件之类的东西吗？

sentences.en: WILLIAM: No - they don't need to see those, don't think.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 不用——他们不需要看那些，我觉得。

sentences.en: AMBER.
sentences.zh: AMBER。

sentences.en: What about my passport?
sentences.zh: 那我的护照呢？

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Oh yes - they will ask to see that.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 哦，对——他们会要求查看你的护照。

sentences.en: AMBER: OK.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 好的。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: I wouldn't get stressed about the interview though.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 不过，你也不必为这次面试过分紧张。

sentences.en: It's just a chance for them to build a relationship with you - so they can try and match you to a job which you'll like.
sentences.zh: 这主要是他们与你建立联系的机会——以便帮你匹配一份你可能会喜欢的工作。

sentences.en: So there are questions about personality that they always ask candidates fairly basic ones.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会问一些关于性格方面的问题，而且总是问应聘者一些相当基础的问题。

sentences.en: And they probably won't ask anything too difficult like what your plans are for the future.
sentences.zh: 而且他们很可能不会问什么特别难的问题，比如你对未来有什么规划。

sentences.en: AMBER: Hope not.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 希望如此。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Anyway, there are lots of benefits to using an agency - for example, the interview will be useful because they'll give you feedback on your performance so you can improve next time.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 无论如何，通过中介机构求职有很多好处——例如，这次面试会很有帮助，因为他们会就你的表现给予反馈，这样你下次就能有所改进。

sentences.en: AMBER: And they'll have access to jobs which aren't advertised.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 而且他们能接触到那些并未公开发布的职位。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Exactly - most temporary jobs aren't advertised.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 没错——大多数临时性工作都不会对外公开招聘。

sentences.en: AMBER: And expect finding a temporary job this way takes a lot less time - it's much easier than ringing up individual companies.
sentences.zh: AMBER: 而且通过这种方式找临时工作通常耗时更少——比起一家家打电话联系公司要轻松得多。

sentences.en: WILLIAM: Yes indeed.
sentences.zh: WILLIAM: 的确如此。

sentences.en: Well I think
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得
